title: Cluster — Events
description: Kubernetes events from VictoriaLogs (all namespaces): warnings by reason and namespace, node restarts and spot preemptions, why pods fail (scheduling, probes, OOM, image pulls), restarts and the event pipeline.

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: (max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)) * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) (kube_node_labels)
list.textFormat: Pool {{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool}} ({{label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning}}): spot preemption, upgrade or repair; its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Warning events
panels.description: Events of type Warning, including repeats of the same event.

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} (k8s.namespace.name:in($namespace) or k8s.namespace.name:="") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:=Warning | stats count() events

panels.title: Pods that could not be scheduled
panels.description: Pods the scheduler could not place: not enough CPU or memory, node affinity, taints or volumes. After a spot preemption the remaining nodes may be too full.

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} (k8s.namespace.name:in($namespace) or k8s.namespace.name:="") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` k8s.event.reason:=FailedScheduling | stats count_uniq(k8s.object.name) pods

panels.title: Failed probes
panels.description: Readiness and liveness probe failures (the pod leaves its Service, or the container is restarted).

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} (k8s.namespace.name:in($namespace) or k8s.namespace.name:="") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` k8s.event.reason:=Unhealthy | stats count() events

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Processes the kernel killed at a container memory limit, reported by node-problem-detector on the node (all namespaces; the event names the process, the pod shows under Container restarts).

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} k8s.event.reason:=OOMKilling _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats count_uniq(_msg) kills

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the time range; the reasons are in the Container restarts table.

targets.expr: sum(round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Node restarts
panels.description: Nodes that booted in the time range: spot VM preemption, node upgrade or repair, or a new node. Their pods were rescheduled; the Nodes row shows when.

targets.expr: count(time() - max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) < $__range_s)

panels.title: Warning events by reason
panels.description: FailedScheduling: no node fits. Unhealthy: probe failed. BackOff: crash or image pull loop. Failed: image pull or container start failed. OOMKilling: memory limit. Evicted / Preempting: node pressure or a higher-priority pod.

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} (k8s.namespace.name:in($namespace) or k8s.namespace.name:="") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:=Warning | stats by (k8s.event.reason) count() events

panels.title: Warning events per namespace
panels.description: When each namespace had warnings; (cluster) is nodes and other cluster-scoped objects.

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} (k8s.namespace.name:in($namespace) or k8s.namespace.name:="") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:=Warning | copy k8s.namespace.name as namespace | format if (namespace:="") "(cluster)" as namespace | stats by (namespace) count() events

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Every node with its GKE node pool, provisioning model and machine type, when it last booted and whether that was in the time range. Spot (and preemptible) nodes can be reclaimed by Compute Engine at any time: a recent boot there usually is a preemption, after which GKE recreated the VM under the same name and its pods were rescheduled. On-demand nodes reboot only for upgrades or repairs. Cause: the most telling node event in the time range (autoscaler ScaleDown, Shutdown, Rebooted, RegisteredNode, NodeNotReady); a node removed by the autoscaler stays listed for a few minutes.

targets.expr: max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) * 1000

time() - max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) < bool $__range_s
max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"})

max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning, label_cloud_google_com_gke_preemptible, label_node_kubernetes_io_instance_type, label_topology_kubernetes_io_zone) (kube_node_labels)

{service.name="kubernetes-events"} k8s.object.kind:=Node k8s.event.reason:in(ScaleDown, Shutdown, NodeShutdown, Rebooted, RegisteredNode, NodeNotReady) | copy k8s.object.name as node | format if (k8s.event.reason:=NodeNotReady) "1" as cause | format if (k8s.event.reason:=RegisteredNode) "2" as cause | format if (k8s.event.reason:=Rebooted) "3" as cause | format if (k8s.event.reason:in(Shutdown, NodeShutdown)) "4" as cause | format if (k8s.event.reason:=ScaleDown) "5" as cause | stats by (node) max(cause) cause, max(_time) last | math round(last/1e6) as cause_ms | delete last

panels.title: Ready nodes by node pool
panels.description: Ready nodes against all nodes, per node pool: a dip is a node lost (preemption, upgrade) until it is back; a rise is the autoscaler adding a node.

targets.expr: sum by (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"} * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool) (kube_node_labels{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool!=""}))

count by (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool) (kube_node_info * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool) (kube_node_labels{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool!=""}))

panels.title: Node events
panels.description: Events on nodes: NodeNotReady, Rebooted, Starting (kubelet), RegisteredNode, OOMKilling and other node-problem-detector findings.

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} k8s.object.kind:=Node _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | format "<k8s.object.kind>/<k8s.object.name> <k8s.event.reason>: <_msg>" as _msg | format if (severity_text:=Warning) "warning" as level | format if (severity_text:=Normal) "info" as level

panels.title: Pods and workloads — why they fail
Warning events by object
panels.description: Events of the selected types per object and message (numbers collapsed), newest first. Click an object to list its events in the explorer.

value.title: Show this object's events in the explorer

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} (k8s.namespace.name:in($namespace) or k8s.namespace.name:="") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:in($type) | copy k8s.namespace.name as namespace | format if (namespace:="") "(cluster)" as namespace | replace_regexp ("\\b[0-9]+\\b", "<N>") at _msg | stats by (namespace, k8s.object.kind, k8s.object.name, k8s.event.reason, _msg) count() events, max(_time) last | math round(last/1e6) as last_ms | delete last | sort by (last_ms desc) | limit 100

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Containers that restarted in the time range and why their runs ended: OOMKilled (memory limit), Error (non-zero exit, failed liveness probe) or Completed. Pods deleted since keep their row.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__range])) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0) or on (namespace, pod, container) (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (round(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Pending pods
panels.description: Pods waiting for a node or for their images. Persisting after a preemption means the remaining nodes are too full (see FailedScheduling).

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) > 0

panels.title: Events — $type
panels.description: Every event as <Kind>/<name> <reason>: <message>. Expand an event for the object, namespace, node and count. Narrow with Message contains and Filters (any field).

targets.expr: {service.name="kubernetes-events"} (k8s.namespace.name:in($namespace) or k8s.namespace.name:="") _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:in($type) | format "<k8s.object.kind>/<k8s.object.name> <k8s.event.reason>: <_msg>" as _msg | format if (severity_text:=Warning) "warning" as level | format if (severity_text:=Normal) "info" as level

panels.title: Events collected
panels.description: Events per second through the k8s-events collector. Failed sends are retried from its queue; the KubeEventsExportFailing alert fires when they persist.

targets.expr: sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(otelcol_exporter_sent_log_records[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Collector queue and memory
panels.description: Events waiting to be sent (left) and the collector's memory (right). A full queue drops events.

targets.expr: sum(otelcol_exporter_queue_size)
sum(otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity)
sum(otelcol_process_memory_rss)
